description: Seeded sample (numpy default_rng(20261102), python -m scripts.audit_samples) of 43 trials stratified by stored endpoint class (4 each from B3-B6, 3 from each other class) after the 2026-11-02 rebuild, in which the classifier sees the investigational drugs' targets; judged by a review agent against the codebook in pipeline/outcomes.py ENDPOINT_SYSTEM from the registered primary outcomes and, for target engagement, the drug's targets.

trials.note: Valoctocogene roxaparvovec delivers F8; FVIII activity is the target's own product, so B1.
Camizestrant is an ESR1 degrader; ER protein expression in tumour is target knockdown, so B1.
Vestronidase alfa replaces GUSB; urinary GAG is that enzyme's substrate, a direct pathway readout (B1; B3 arguable since uGAG supported the MPS VII approval); first-listed uGAG outcome governs.
Febuxostat targets XDH; serum creatinine in renal impairment is a disease measure, not the XDH readout (uric acid), and not an accepted surrogate here, so B2.
Finerenone targets NR3C2; NT-proBNP in heart failure is a non-surrogate disease biomarker, so B2.
Evolocumab targets PCSK9; arterial FDG-PET inflammation is an exploratory imaging biomarker, not a PCSK9/LDL readout, so B2.
MBL responder by alkaline hematin (<80 mL and >=50% reduction) is the endpoint FDA approved GnRH antagonists for fibroid bleeding on, so B3 (B4 also defensible).
Factor B inhibitor in PNH; haemoglobin rise without transfusion is the accepted anaemia surrogate (not a complement-activity readout), so B3.
Ferumoxytol in iron-deficiency anaemia; change in haemoglobin is the accepted surrogate, so B3; first of two haemoglobin primaries governs.
LDL-C is listed first with no hierarchy, so it governs; the codebook names LDL-C as B3 (even though rosuvastatin's HMGCR pathway leads to it).
Luvadaxistat (DAO inhibitor); BACS composite is a performance-based cognitive battery, so B4 is defensible, though the codebook's ADAS-Cog example would put cognitive tests in B5.
Setmelanotide (MC4R agonist); >=5% BMI reduction is body weight, which the codebook places in B4.
Percent body-weight change is the only efficacy primary (the rest are OLE safety), so index 1 and B4 per the codebook.
Indacaterol in COPD; peak inspiratory capacity is spirometry but not the accepted FEV1 surrogate, so B4.
ADAS-Cog total score is listed in B5.
MADRS is a clinician-rated scale, B5.
HFMSE is a clinician-administered motor function scale, B5 (nusinersen's SMN2 target not measured).
Investigator live assessment of glabellar line severity is a clinician-rated scale, B5.
Two pain primaries with no hierarchy; first listed (SPID-6 on patient NRS) governs, B6.
Patient-rated migraine pain reduction at 2 h, B6.
TOTPAR is a sum of patient pain-relief ratings, B6.
Pain VAS on movement is the efficacy primary (the second is AEs), B6.
LB1148 (oral tranexamic acid) in post-operative ileus; time to GI-2 recovery is a time-to-event clinical milestone, B7 defensible (the codebook has no recovery-milestone class; B6 could be argued).
Sapablursen (TMPRSS6 knockdown) in PV; phlebotomy frequency is a disease-event rate, not a TMPRSS6/hepcidin readout, so B7.
Major haemorrhage after an endobronchial procedure is a bleeding event, B7.
Incidence of confirmed herpes zoster in a vaccine prevention trial is incident disease, B8.
VTE or all-cause death composite includes death, B8.
Worst-outcome ordinal scale led by death in AMI is the primary efficacy measure and includes death, B8; second primary is bleeding safety.
SVR12 is virologic cure of HCV, B9 (B3 viral-load surrogate is the equivalent alternative under the codebook).
Sustained viral response in HCV is virologic cure, B9 (equivalently B3).
Clinical and microbiological recovery from vulvovaginal candidiasis, B9.
IRC-assessed ORR, O1.
ORR, O1.
ORR per modified RECIST, O1.
PFS, O2.
DFS at final analysis (first of two DFS timepoints), O2.
DFS events, O2.
Overall survival, O3.
Overall survival, O3.
Overall survival, O3.
AEs/SAEs as the only primary, safety_tolerability, not_efficacy.
Absorbed radiation dose in organs is dosimetry, pk_pd_dose, not_efficacy.
All twelve primaries are safety measures; TEAE incidence governs, not_efficacy.
